subject: design-technology
title: Sustainability and the 6 Rs
welcome_lead: Rethink, refuse, reduce, reuse, repair, recycle.
meta_desc: A-Level D&T: sustainability principles and the 6 Rs.
final_note: Most environmental impact is locked in at the design stage.

concepts.def: Rethink, Refuse, Reduce, Reuse, Repair, Recycle.
Energy consumed to extract, manufacture and transport a product.
Total greenhouse gas emissions caused by an entity/product.
System in which materials cycle indefinitely without waste.
Designing a product to fail or become outdated within a set time.
Movement and legislation enabling consumer/independent repair.

walkthroughs.body_html: The 6 Rs rank waste-prevention strategies — Rethink first (do we need this product at all?), through Reduce/Reuse/Repair, to Recycle as last resort. Design decides where in the hierarchy a product lives.
For a typical car, ~20% of life-cycle CO2 is embodied (manufacture), 80% use-phase. For an LED bulb, ratio inverts. Embodied energy dominates short-life electronics.
The UK introduced right to repair regulations in July 2021 for white goods and TVs, requiring spare-part availability for 7-10 years. EU regulations extended similarly.
